Ezekiel; plural מִכְשֹׁלִים Jer 6:21 + Ezek 21:20 ᵑ0 ( Co and others מֻכְשָׁלִים , see below ); — 1. stumbling , ׳ צוּר מ Isa 8:14 (fig) a rock of stumbling (i.e. over which one stumbles); literal הַרְבֵּה הַמִּכְשֹׁלִים Ezek 21:20 an abundance of stumblings, falls (si vera lectio; ᵐ5 . οἱ ἀσθενοῦντες, apparently reading participle, compare Sm; so Co Da (as a possibility), i.e. מֻכְשָׁלִים Hoph`al Participle of כשׁל = those who have stumbled or been overthrown ). 2. means, or occasion of stumbling, stumbling-block ; a literal Lev 19:14 . \ \ b. figurative of misfortune, calamity Paslm Lev 119:16 5; in divine judgment Jer 6:21 ; Ezek 3:20 , as a hindrance to restoration of people Isa 57:14 . \ \ c. in ethical sense עֲוֺנָם ׳ מ Ezek 7:19 a stumbling-block of (i.e. occasioning) their iniquity , so Ezek 14:3 ; Ezek 14:4 ; Ezek 14:7 ; Ezek 18:30 ; Ezek 44:12 (mostly with reference to idols.). \ \ d. לֵב ׳ מ 1Sam 25:31 a stumbling-block of heart i.e. ground for remorse.

מִכְשׁוֺל noun masculineJer 6:21 a stumbling, means or occasion of stumbling, stumbling-block; — ׳מ absolute Isa 8:14 + 3 t., מִכְשֹׁל Lev 19:14 construct מִכְשׁוֺל 1Sam 25:31 + 6 t. Ezekiel; plural מִכְשֹׁלִים Jer 6:21 + Ezek 21:20 ᵑ0 (Co and others מֻכְשָׁלִים, see below); —

1. stumbling, ׳צוּר מ Isa 8:14 (fig) a rock of stumbling (i.e. over which one stumbles); literal הַרְבֵּה הַמִּכְשֹׁלִים Ezek 21:20 an abundance of stumblings, falls (si vera lectio; ᵐ5. οἱ ἀσθενοῦντες, apparently reading participle, compare Sm; so Co Da (as a possibility), i.e. מֻכְשָׁלִים Hoph`al Participle of כשׁל = those who have stumbled or been overthrown).
2. means, or occasion of stumbling, stumbling-block; a literal Lev 19:14.
\ \ b. figurative of misfortune, calamity Paslm Lev 119:165; in divine judgment Jer 6:21; Ezek 3:20, as a hindrance to restoration of people Isa 57:14.
\ \ c. in ethical sense עֲוֺנָם ׳מ Ezek 7:19 a stumbling-block of (i.e. occasioning) their iniquity, so Ezek 14:3; Ezek 14:4; Ezek 14:7; Ezek 18:30; Ezek 44:12 (mostly with reference to idols.).
\ \ d. לֵב ׳מ 1Sam 25:31 a stumbling-block of heart i.e. ground for remorse.
